description.narrative: "Assistance to EAC Countries and Secretariat: Trade-Climate Change-Food Security Linkages and Multilateral Trade Negotiations" The objective of the project is to build capacity among relevant stakeholders in the EAC region to better understand the linkages between Climate Ch.-Food Security-Trade and to create policies for mitigation and adaptation to CC with the help of Trade Policy.

"Assistance to EAC Countries and Secretariat: Trade-Climate Change-Food Security Linkages and Multilateral Trade Negotiations". Målet med insatsen är att bygga kapacitet hos relevanta intressenter i EAC regionen för att bättre förstå länkarna mellan klimatförändringar-livsmedelssäkerhet-handel samt att skapa policies för förebyggande och anpassing till CC med hjälp av handelspolitik.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: CUTS has delivered on all the three objectives in accordance with the revised logframe from 2014. Objective 1: Increased knowledge and capacity on CCFST - The report states all the outputs have been delivered upon. In several cases, the project has overachieved, e.g. number of participants in training and meetings as well as number of initiatives emerged from stakeholders. Objective 2: Improved understanding and capacity of EAC Geneva missions - 24 bimonthly meetings has been organized in the Geneva Forum for EAC delegates to WTO. All delegates report that they have increased their capacity as a result of their participation. Objective 3: Enhanced coordination between and across stakeholders - CUTS reports frequent interaction between Geneva and capitals, as well as national-regional, national-national and regional-multilateral. Several participants in National Reference groups are collaborating on Climate change, food security and trade issues.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
